summary: A Coinbase user attempting to withdraw tokens to a cold wallet received scam warnings and a withdrawal block then contacted support through a callback inside the app. During the call the representative instructed the user to ignore on screen warnings stating they were not on a call with Coinbase suggesting a support impersonation attempt.
user_mistake: Continuing interaction after being told to ignore in app security warnings
prevention: Terminate calls that instruct ignoring platform security warnings / Recontact support only through verified in app channels
